notes.title: Discount for Spring Sale and walkthrough getting released.
notes.content:
🌸 Unleash the Chaos: The Supernatural Power Troll Hits the Steam Spring Sale! 🌸
[b]Steam Spring Sale: March 13 – 20[/b]

Spring has sprung, and so has the madness! "The Supernatural Power Troll" is crashing the Steam Spring Sale with a mischievous grin and a bag full of chaotic powers. If you’ve ever wanted to play as a troll who “helps” humans by granting them hilariously disastrous abilities, now’s your chance to dive into the fun at a special Spring Sale price!

📺 Level Solutions Unveiled: Master Every Challenge!
To celebrate the Spring Sale, I’m thrilled to announce the release of a complete walkthrough playlist featuring solutions for every single level of "The Supernatural Power Troll." Crafted by the game’s level designer (yours truly!), this playlist is your ultimate guide to trolling like a pro.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLmCE_HYLQCo1K3ZkmquCYZHgvwpsPfE9e]Watch the full playlist on YouTube[/url]


Why Check Out the Walkthrough?
Stuck on a Level? Get step-by-step solutions to overcome any obstacle.
Curious About Strategy? See the intended paths and clever tricks designed for each stage.
Maximize the Fun: Discover hidden mechanics, alternative approaches, and ways to rack up higher scores.
Whether you’re a newbie troll or a seasoned chaos-bringer, these videos will elevate your game and deepen your appreciation for the madness.

🔍 What’s "The Supernatural Power Troll" All About?
Picture this: You’re a troll with a twisted sense of humor and a knack for supernatural mischief. Your mission? “Bless” unsuspecting humans with powers they can’t handle—like turning them into walking disasters or giving them abilities that backfire spectacularly. Every NPC is a unique snowflake, with randomized appearances, personalities, and reactions, ensuring no two playthroughs are ever the same.

Gameplay Highlights:
Sandbox Chaos: Experiment with powers like enemy-stomping jumps, vase-tossing mayhem, and more.
Creative Solutions: Each level offers multiple ways to win—find your own style of trolling!
Endless Laughs: Watch NPCs flail, freak out, and fail in the most entertaining ways possible.
This isn’t just a game—it’s a playground of supernatural shenanigans where YOU decide how wild things get.

🚀 Spring Into Action!
The Steam Spring Sale won’t last forever, and neither will this chance to snag "The Supernatural Power Troll" at a discount. Grab the game, explore the walkthrough playlist, and let your inner troll run wild.

Get ready to troll harder, laugh louder, and unleash supernatural chaos like never before. See you in the Spring Sale, chaos-makers!

notes.title: The Supernatural Power Troll is now released on Steam
notes.content:
The game is now out on Steam at a 15% discount!

Get it while it's hot!
It's got:
- A crazy troll
- Tons of superpowers you can throw at humans
- Funny cutscenes
- 50 levels to beat + 10 boss levels
- A level editor!
